findings.codeql_raw_query:
/**
 * @name Unsafe file operations in certifi
 * @description Path traversal or unsafe file access in certifi package
 * @kind problem
 * @problem.severity medium
 * @id py/unsafe-file-access
 * @tags security
 *        external/cwe/cwe-022
 */

import python
import semmle.python.ApiGraphs

from DataFlow::CallCfgNode call
where
  call = API::moduleImport("os").getMember(["open", "remove", "unlink", "rename", "chmod", "chown"]).getACall() or
  call = API::moduleImport("shutil").getMember(["copy", "move", "rmtree"]).getACall() or
  call = API::moduleImport("builtins").getMember("open").getACall()
select call, "Potentially unsafe file operation that could be vulnerable to path traversal."
findings.hypothesis: Path traversal or unsafe file access vulnerabilities in certifi package
